definitions: Any of various sports or skills, mainly of Japanese and Chinese origin, that originated as forms of self-defense or attack, such as judo, karate, and kendo.
A system of codified practices and traditions of combat, practiced for a variety of reasons including self-defense, physical fitness, mental and spiritual development, and competition.
examples: He has been studying martial art for five years.
Many martial art forms emphasize discipline and respect.
Learning a martial art can improve physical and mental well-being.
